split_load_energy.status: Illustrative state averages, not measured radio, MCU or motor power
split_load_energy.note: Motor branch current is measured at the battery side, not winding PWM current. Awake logic is a separate load. Idle pack current includes all idle components and normal radio behavior. Additional service wakes replace idle time; use zero additional time if the measured idle average already includes those wakes. The 73 mA row is only a radio RX reference, not a complete application estimate.
